runs.scenario: GitHub Actions Script Injection — Use env Variables Instead of Inline Interpolation (github-actions-code-injection)
runs.content:
The error "GitHub Actions Script Injection — Use env Variables Instead of Inline Interpolation" is raised when GitHub Actions detects that inline interpolation is being used in a script. This is a security risk because inline interpolation can be used to inject arbitrary code into the workflow.

To fix this error, you can replace inline interpolation with environment variables. Here's how you can do it:

**Before:**
```yml
name: My Workflow
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Run script
        run: |
          echo "Hello, World!"
```

**After:**
```yml
name: My Workflow
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Run script
        run: |
          echo "$GITHUB_TOKEN" # or any other environment variable
```
